3.message: Expected more for the price. The landing was disappointing, allocated 30mins with not much to see. more flight time with close up views of the glacier would have made the activity better

5.message: This was like once a lifetime activity. The view of glacier is breathtaking and the time spent on the glacier is incredible Also, our tour guide and expedition pilot, Alec Salazar, was amazing and wonderful guide. We were able to spot couple of bears and mountain goats on our way back to the deck thanks to Alec! This tour is worth the $$ spent!!!
Es war ein wunderschöner Flug ,auch die Landung am Gletscher war eine sehr schöne Erfahrung und wir hatten uns auf dem gesamten Flug sehr sicher gefühlt . Kann es nur jedem empfehlen.
It was so exciting and our pilot Ryan was such a great guy as we had never been on a helicopter before and he reassured us and made the whole experience a once in a lifetime opportunity.

Esperienza magnifica ! Il nostro pilota è stato fantastico e super educato! La vista ripaga i soldi spesi , assolutamente. Esperienza fatta con bimba di un anno , molto fattibile ; lo dico perché quando programmavo le attività da fare avrei voluto trovare un commento di una famiglia con bimba dj un anno 😂
our guide was from the area, and was very knowledgeable. He was very aware of his surroundings which elevated the experience and our safety. looking forward to our next visit !!
Surreal experience! Definitely must visit and experience the glacier water!
Was the most favorite experience of our Alaskan vacation?
My 21yo son says it was the highlight of our trip. Thank you!
Fun, informative, and safe!

The helicopter ride was incredible! It was the first time we’d been in a helicopter and we were nervous but the ride was so smooth and easy! We loved every minute of it. The views exceeded our expectations. Our guide was so knowledgeable and he helped us climb and even offered us spikes for our shoes if we wanted to keep climbing on slick terrain. He took us a few different routes so we could see more of the glacier and see wildlife. 10/10 recommend!
Sehr gut. Alex ist ein toller Pilot und ein sehr freundlicher und sympathischer Mensch.
素晴らしかった
exellente découverte avec guide extra
Highly recommended!!! 💯
Espectacular! La cereza del pastel hubiera sido que el guía hablara español 🤗
10,000/10! It was incredible! The entire staff is so friendly! The tour is breathtaking! I highly recommend this amazing experience! Huge thanks to all the staff

We had a great experience with Knik Glacier Helicopter Tour. My wife was a little apprehensive about the helicopter, being her first time, but throughly enjoyed the trip. Our guide/pilot Liam was fantastic and very informative and accommodating. The whole crew were wonderful and easy to deal with. Landing on the Glacier is something special that we will remember forever. We would recommend this experience to anyone.
Everyone was super nice and made us feel welcomed. Had an amazing experience!!
Amazing!
Wow!! They are superb and what and amazing adventure! They made us feel comfortable and safe at all time with such an amazing team of professional. Tky guys!!!
Tour bellissimo, sopra le aspettative, mezz’ora sul ghiacciaio e volo stupendo

L’esperienza più incredibile della nostra vita!! Abbiamo visto paesaggi pazzeschi, é impagabile poter atterrare sul ghiacciaio, vedere il blu dell’acqua scorrere sul ghiaccio, camminare con i propri piedi in un paesaggio da sogno! Il costo è proporzionato all’esperienza magnifica che farete durante il vostro viaggio in Alaska! Un ringraziamento speciale alla nostra guida eccellente Hayden, è stato fantastico!! Grazie!

Unser Pilot Trevor war super sympathisch und zuvorkommend. Die Kulisse war atemberaubend und sehr divers - von sattem Grün an den Bergen zu kräftigem Blau im Gletscher war alles vorhanden. Wir haben und zu jedem Zeitpunkt sicher gefühlt. Die Tour ist etwas teuer aber lohnt sich.
Det var en super fed oplevelse, ikke noget at sætte en finger på
Unbeschreibliche tolle Natur. Wir hatten Sonnenschein pur und die Landung auf dem Gletscher war wunderschön!
Loved it!!!!!! Best day I spent in beautiful Alaska. Our pilot Kyle was wonderful
Rien. Tout était parfait
The best tour of our whole stay in Alaska – stunning views and a super friendly tour leader!

Nezapomenutelný zážitek! Let vrtulníkem na ledovec Knik byl naprostý vrchol našeho pobytu na Aljašce. Už samotný let nad divokou krajinou byl dechberoucí – nekonečné lesy, horské štíty a modravé ledovcové řeky pod námi. Když jsme přistáli přímo na ledovci, ocitli jsme se v jiném světě – tichém, křišťálově čistém a naprosto magickém. Vidět zblízka modrá jezírka vyhloubená ledem a cítit tu ledovou sílu pod nohama byl zážitek, na který se nezapomíná. Průvodce byl skvělý, přátelský a znalý, ochotně odpovídal na všechny dotazy a udělal nám krásné fotky. Celá organizace byla profesionální a cítili jsme se po celou dobu v bezpečí.

Wir sind so happy, das wir diese Tour erleben durften. Alles war perfekt trotz des regnerischen Wetters. Ein Erlebnis was sehr beeindruckend war und was wir nie vergessen werden. Danke an unserem Piloten.
widok i lot helikopterem niezapomniany, polecam!
Great experience you couldn’t have without a helicopter… a top highlight of our winter Alaska vacation.

Our Pilot Cody was very fun engaging and informative. We had alot of fun and really enjoyed the helicopter ride. The lady in the office did a great job also and made us feel at home. Would definitely recommend this activity.
We had such a great time! Pictures can’t capture the true beauty, wow! Our pilot Sam was great, super nice and knowledgeable. We saw so many moose too! You won’t regret booking this.
Same was a great pilot it was so awesome

How knowledgeable everyone was! My sister who is a bit older needed a little extra assistance! Everyone was Extremely helpful and Kind Michael our Guide was very social and his knowledge was credible. We will def be back again!

Christian was a great pilot and guide along the glacier. He was very informative and helped us find the best spots to be in and helped us spot some wildlife along the way. This might have been one of the best experiences I’ve ever had and would highly recommend it for anyone else visiting Alaska. Would love to see it in the summer time as well but it was a real gem going on a wintery day in the sun.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ service! The entire experience was great from beginning to end. We had physical limitations in our party and the staff was so patient, kind and accommodating. All of the staff are amazing and our pilot, Adam, was phenomenal. Breathtaking views worth every penny. 10/10, we recommend!
We absolutely loved it. Breathtaking views!!!
Bellissima esperienza!!! Da vedere assolutamente! Il nostro pilota era davvero esperto e paziente! I panorami sono stupendi! Grazie mille!
Super Erlebnis

Todo estuvo muy bien, un poco apenados pues por parte de nosotros queríamos volar 4 personas en un helicóptero, lo cual por regla de seguridad, peso y espacio era imposible, en cuanto nos explicaron la capacidad entendimos perfecto y volamos 2 pax en cada uno. Los pilotos excelentes, la empresa cumplió con todo lo que promete, tienen unos escenarios hermosos. Gracias por todo.

It was wonderful😀

Es war unglaublich, wie schön diese noch weitgehend unberührte Natur ist. Und vielen Dank an unseren Piloten Bailey, der ein wahrer Meister seines Fachs ist. All the Best, Guys 🙏🏻
The whole experience was amazing! The pilot was very informative and the glacial was spectacular. We were also lucky to see while inflight some wildlife. Black bear, mountain goats and moose! ~AJ
